The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: an open public place in a town.

notes: Do not confuse 'plac' (an urban square or designated outdoor area) with 'miejsce' (a general word for 'place' or 'space').
Takes the preposition 'na' for both location ('na placu' – in the square) and direction ('na plac' – to the square).

senses.definition: An open public area in a town or city, usually where several streets meet.

examples.text: Spotkamy się na głównym placu miasta.
examples.translation: We will meet at the main town square.
examples.emotion: excited and ready to meet up in the center of town

senses.definition: An outdoor area used for a specific purpose, such as a playground or construction site.

examples.text: Dzieci bawią się na placu zabaw.
examples.translation: The children are playing on the playground.

notes: Do not confuse 'plac' (square or plot) with 'miejsce' (place or space). While 'miejsce' is general, 'plac' specifically refers to an open urban square or a designated plot of land.
